newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Arafat to Jordan for courtesy visit with king.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to Jordan for courtesy visit with king.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat left self-ruled Gaza for Amman on Tuesday on a one-day courtesy visit to Jordan's King Hussein who underwent a minor knee surgery, PLO officials said.
Aides said Arafat planned to visit Jordan on Monday but the trip was put off because of bad weather.
Jordanian officials have said Arafat was also due to hold talks with Crown Prince Hassan and Prime Minister Abdul-Karim al-Kabariti on Middle East peace moves.
